meta.title: Glass backdrop
meta.description: A wallpaper behind the Harness UI. Drag the sliders in Settings to set how much the background shows through and how soft the frosted glass is.

enable.title: Glass backdrop
enable.description: Puts a wallpaper behind the interface and turns the panels into translucent frosted glass.
enable.label: On

visibility.title: Background visibility
visibility.description: How much of the wallpaper shows through the interface. Higher values look more transparent but soften text contrast.

blur.title: Glass blur
blur.description: Frosting strength of the glass mask. At 0 the wallpaper stays crisp behind the panels.
